critical_rules: UI capability is not AI principal authority.
Registered command/wrapper is not proof of live active path.
DONE documentation goal does not imply runtime delivery.
Live model availability comes from runtime discovery.
Connected external resources do not become ambient model context.
ProjectAgent identity does not imply Mission execution.
Restore does not restore device grants or credentials.
